text:
```yaml
name: Stale Pull Requests

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Runs daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Mark stale pull requests
        uses: actions/stale@v9
        with:
          days-before-stale: 15
          days-before-close: 7
          stale-label: 'stale'
          exempt-pr-labels: 'pinned,work-in-progress,on-hold'
          close-message: 'This pull request has been automatically closed because it was inactive for more than 7 days.'
          stale-message: 'This pull request has been marked as stale because it has been inactive for over 15 days. Please let us know if you will be able to continue working on it soon, or if we should close it.'
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
